$comment: LandmarkLayer (M02d1; 02-world-bake.md section 7 rules 3 and 5). resident = most landmark models resident at once; swapM = distance inside which a landmark's model replaces its baked extrusion proxies. A resident landmark is released at swapM x unloadFactor (hysteresis, BD-M02d1-02). A failed load is tried again after retryMs.
